_notes: These are mostly responsory/antiphon texts that paraphrase or composite scripture loosely; the Vulgate wording often differs from CUV/Studium so I rendered faithfully in liturgical register, matching official CUV wording where the verse is verbatim. Anchored verbatim to CUV(RCU17SS): Job 1:21, Joel 2:13, Gen 8:1-3, Ps 137:1/5-6, Acts 2:2-4, Ps 69:1. Job/扫罗/基利波山/以利亚/拿撒勒 names per CUV. Deus=神 throughout; Allelúia=阿肋路亚. 'cornuta esset facies' (Moses' face) rendered as 发出光芒/光彩 per CUV's 'face shone' rather than Vulgate's literal 'horned'. Tobit responsories (Sufficiébat nobis paupértas / Heu me fili mi) are deuterocanonical (Tobit 5) but Studium page not fetched; rendered faithfully.
